caseNameFull: LOMAS MORTGAGE USA v. Daniel WIESE GOLDOME REALTY CREDIT CORP. v. Mark Christian SAUGSTAD and GENERAL MOTORS ACCEPTANCE CORPORATION v. Noel G. CERVANTES

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgments are vacated and the case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for further consideration in light of Nobelman v. American Savings Bank, 508 U.S. -, 113 S.Ct. 2106, — L.Ed.2d-(1993).
